WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.rfistat,
    sa.avg_modindex,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex
  FROM with_overall
  WHERE avg_modindex > overall_avg
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_of_qualifying
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT 
  wo.rfistat as status,
  wo.avg_modindex as average_modulation_index,
  wo.avg_modindex - wo.overall_avg as above_average,
  wo.avg_modindex - qm.mean_of_qualifying as differs_from_mean
FROM with_overall wo
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
WHERE wo.avg_modindex > wo.overall_avg
ORDER BY wo.rfistat
